summary: Vitalik 回应 bunker mode：不建议今天就急着换钱包，但应认真对待 AI 加速数学对密码学的风险。soispoke 发文说明 EIP-8288 如何让隐私应用在用户设备上生成后量子证明、由节点在 EVM 外验证。账户抽象规范大调整：EIP-8130 收窄为 Keystore，交易类型拆到新 EIP；EIP-8141、EIP-7906、EIP-8250 多个 frame 相关 PR 合并。ACDE #247 当晚召开。

items.title: ethresear.ch：为以太坊上的后量子证明暴露一个 ISA
items.note: 22:34（soispoke，推文 22:59）。EIP-8288 让交易依赖 leanSPHINCS 签名和 leanSTARK 证明，它们写在 EIP-8141 frame 交易的依赖帧里，节点转发前先检查，每个区块带一个证明全部依赖有效的递归 STARK。现在的隐私池在合约里用 BN254 配对预编译验证 Groth16 证明，量子计算机攻破 BN254 就能伪造；有了 EIP-8288，池合约只需检查交易依赖了自己电路的证明和预期公共输入。文章比较 EVM、RISC-V 和专为证明设计的 eISA。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: exposing an ISA for post-quantum proofs on Ethereum
items.note_en: 22:34 (soispoke, post at 22:59). EIP-8288 lets transactions depend on leanSPHINCS signatures and leanSTARK proofs declared in the dependency frame of an EIP-8141 frame transaction. Nodes check them before forwarding, and each block carries one recursive STARK proving all its dependencies valid. Today's privacy pools verify Groth16 proofs in-contract with the BN254 pairing precompile, which a quantum computer that breaks BN254 could forge. With EIP-8288, the pool contract only checks that the transaction depends on a proof for its own circuit with the expected public inputs. The post compares the EVM, RISC-V and an eISA designed for proving.

summary_en: Vitalik responded to bunker mode: he does not recommend scrambling to move funds today, but the risks to cryptography from AI-accelerated math should be taken seriously. soispoke explained how EIP-8288 lets privacy apps generate post-quantum proofs on user devices while nodes verify them outside the EVM. Account abstraction specs were reshaped: EIP-8130 is narrowed to the Keystore with its transaction type moved to a new EIP, and several frame-related PRs to EIP-8141, EIP-7906 and EIP-8250 were merged. ACDE #247 met in the evening.
